articles.headline: Hajime Moriyasu unbothered how he's remembered. Perhaps that is his Japan legacy
articles.description: Hajime Moriyasu is not bothered by how he will be remembered as Japan coach -- and perhaps that is the legacy he leaves behind.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Hajime Moriyasu's time in charge of Japan came to an end on Tuesday with the Samurai Blue falling to a 2-1 loss to Uruguay in an international friendly at Singapore's National Stadium.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: In his farewell chapter, Hajime Moriyasu was received widespread adulation from the Japan faithful but insists he hasn't thought too much about how he will be remembered by.

articles.headline: Stoic until the end, Japan's Hajime Moriyasu can finally let emotions flow
articles.description: Even up until the eve of his final game in charge of Japan, Hajime Moriyasu remained solely focused on the task ahead.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Having taken over the Japan reins after the 2018 FIFA World Cup, Hajime Moriyasu will manage the Samurai Blue for the final time on Tuesday against Paraguay at Singapore's National Stadium.

images.name: Hajime Moriyasu [1296x729]
images.caption: Hajime Moriyasu ultimately did not succeed in helping Japan claim a first-ever knockout win at the FIFA World Cup, but he did guide them from 55th in the FIFA rankings to their current position of world No. 17.

articles.headline: Singapore coach Gavin Lee still relishing Brazil tie -- even if Carlo Ancelotti moment no longer on the cards
articles.description: Singapore coach Gavin Lee is still relishing Tuesday's meeting with Brazil -- even if opposite number Carlo Ancelotti will not be on the touchline.

images.name: Japan vs. Brazil: Carlo Ancelotti [1296x729]
images.caption: Carlo Ancelotti will be absent from the touchline when Brazil take on Singapore on Tuesday after being sent off in the controversial end of his team's 3-2 loss to Japan at the weekend.

images.name: Singapore vs. Paraguay: Gavin Lee [1296x729]
images.caption: After last week's 4-1 loss to Paraguay, Gavin Lee and his Singapore team face another huge challenge at the National Stadium on Tuesday in the form of five-time FIFA World Cup champions Brazil.

articles.headline: Stars set Singapore alight as Japan exact revenge on Brazil with dramatic late win
articles.description: Japan have exacted revenge over Brazil for their World Cup elimination with a dramatic 3-2 win in Singapore on Saturday.

images.name: Japan vs. Brazil [1296x729]
images.caption: Japan exacted revenge on Brazil for their heartbreaking World Cup elimination earlier this year by recording a 3-2 win over the latter in Singapore on Saturday.
images.credit: Roslan RAHMAN / AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Japan vs. Brazil: Raphinha; Hiroki Ito [1296x729]
images.caption: After claiming a two-goal lead inside the opening 19 minutes, Japan allowed Brazil to get back into the game before sealing the win with a dramatic winner in the 91st minute.
images.credit: Roslan RAHMAN / AFP via Getty Images

articles.headline: Song Ui-Young gives Lions one moment to roar as Paraguay hand Singapore lesson in levels
articles.description: Singapore will have valuable lessons to take from Friday's 4-1 loss to FIFA World Cup opposition in the form of Paraguay.

images.name: Singapore vs. Paraguay: Song Ui-Young [1296x729]
images.caption: Song Ui-Young scored for Singapore with a fine header on Friday but it ultimately proved to be a consolation in a 4-1 loss to Paraguay.

images.name: Singapore vs. Paraguay: Julio Enciso [1296x729]
images.caption: With Premier League-proven talent such as Ipswich Town forward Julio Enciso and ex-Newcastle star Miguel Almirón to call upon, Paraguay just had too much quality for Singapore in their 4-1 win on Friday.

articles.headline: Glamour Paraguay, Brazil ties offer Singapore more than just chance for redemption after Malaysia humiliation
articles.description: Singapore will have plenty of motivation when they take on Paraguay and Brazil -- and not just because of the glitz and glamour of the occasion.

images.name: Singapore vs. Malaysia [1296x729]
images.caption: Singapore will be looking to bounce back from a humiliating 6-0 loss to bitter rivals Malaysia in their last outing when they take on Paraguay and Brazil in glamour friendlies over the next five days.
images.credit: Pakawich Damrongkiattisak - FIFA/FIFA via Getty Images
